body: Register row B-30 (docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md): besides the command, a forgotten password has two more gaps. (1) The owner-made reset link and the list of one's own devices are built on the server and have NO screen in the app (docs/32 D-1, AC-6, DV-3): a friend who is sent a reset link cannot use it. (2) Under D-61 the Host's side must be a button as well as a command, and the Host's own password cannot be a plain button on a page anyone on the network can open: the proof of 'I am the Host' is physical (a code printed on the server computer or the install's recovery file). Design both doors on one operation.
